# Developer experience review

Trace the intended developer from installation or first API call to a successful result. Identify the first working command, prerequisites, authentication, configuration, error messages, recovery, and documentation. Measure time to first success when a working environment exists; otherwise identify what prevents measurement. Check a new interface from its caller's point of view rather than reviewing internal elegance alone.

Add the concrete first-run path, error cases, and acceptance checks to the same plan. Skip this perspective when no developer-facing workflow changes. Preserve existing user decisions and return to the parent plan flow.
